sources.author: Letterboxd Stremio Bridge
patch_list: Adds a purple Stremio button directly below the trailer button on film pages, styled identically to it. Takes the trailer button's position when there is no trailer. Opens the film directly in the Stremio app or web player.
Hides the sponsored "Spotlight" ad card on the home feed. Can be toggled independently of the other patches.

Hides the "Rent from Letterboxd Video Store" banner on film pages, the video store carousel row on the home feed, and the "Letterboxd Video Store" row in the search page's "Browse by" list. Can be toggled independently of the other patches.
Hides the "Where to watch" streaming-service icon row on film pages. Can be toggled independently of the other patches.
